PictureThis® identifies millions of plants daily with over 98% accuracy, making plant care simple and accessible. Whether you're a seasoned gardener or a new plant parent, PictureThis is your essential tool for plant identification and care.

Key Features:
Accurate Plant Identifier
Renowned as the best plant identification app, PictureThis can identify over 400,000 plant species with unparalleled accuracy. Simply take a picture, and our engine will instantly provide the plant's name and detailed information. Curious about a beautiful plant you saw on a walk? Snap a photo, and let PictureThis do the rest!

Plant Disease Auto Diagnose & Cure
Take a photo of a sick plant, and PictureThis will diagnose the disease and offer treatment advice. It’s like having a plant doctor on call! If your favorite houseplant develops brown spots, use PictureThis to receive a diagnosis and a step-by-step treatment plan to restore its health.

Plant Care Tips & Reminders
Get detailed care instructions, including watering schedules, fertilization times, and optimal light conditions, ensuring your plants thrive.

Toxic Plant Warning
Identify toxic plants and receive warnings to keep your pets, children, and family safe. Unsure if a new plant is safe for your pets? PictureThis will alert you if the plant is toxic and provide safety guidelines to protect your loved ones.

Weed Identification
Easily identify weeds in your garden and get tips on how to control or remove them. Notice a new plant growing in your garden beds? Snap a photo with PictureThis to confirm if it’s a weed and receive guidance on how to manage it effectively.

Water Tracker & Reminder
Never forget to water your plants again with timely notifications. Have a busy schedule? PictureThis sends reminders to keep your plants hydrated and healthy without the guesswork.

Light Exposure Monitoring
Track how much sunlight your plant is getting with our light meter to ensure it’s receiving the right amount of light. Concerned your indoor plant isn’t getting enough light? Use the PictureThis light meter to check its exposure and adjust its position for optimal growth.

Manage Your Plant Collection
Track all the plants you identify and build your own plant wishlist. Create your personal fingertip garden with PictureThis.

Expert Consultation
Have plant-related questions? Chat with our experts 24/7 to get personalized advice and tips tailored to your specific gardening needs.

Join PictureThis today and elevate your gardening experience! Identify, learn, and care for your plants with us. Let’s make the world greener, one plant at a time.

Discover plants around you and organize your plant care routine with Plant App. Use AI-powered plant identification to explore flowers, trees, succulents, herbs, and more from a photo.

Keep your plants in a personal collection, record notes, and set reminders for everyday care—all in one place.

– PLANT APP FEATURES –

PLANT IDENTIFIER
Explore plant identification from photos. Whether you’re curious about a flower, tree, succulent, or weed, Plant App helps you find possible matches and browse information about the suggested plants.

Identification results may vary depending on image quality and the plant photographed.

PLANT CARE & DISEASE INFORMATION
Upload a photo to explore possible plant health issues and related care information. Learn about common symptoms, potential causes, and suggested care steps to help you better understand your plant’s condition.

Photo-based assessments may not identify every issue and do not confirm a diagnosis or guarantee that a plant is healthy. For persistent or unclear problems, consult a qualified plant care professional.

PLANT CARE GUIDES
Learn about your plants’ watering, light, and fertilizer needs. Browse care guides to help plan your routine and understand how growing conditions can affect your plants.

Use the guidance as a starting point and adjust your care based on your plant’s condition and environment.

WATER CALCULATOR
Get estimated watering recommendations based on plant type and pot size. Actual watering needs can vary with soil, drainage, light, temperature, and humidity. Check your plant and soil before watering.

NOTES AND REMINDERS
Set reminders for watering, fertilizing, and repotting. Create custom reminders for other care tasks and keep notes to track changes in your plants over time.

PERSONAL PLANT COLLECTION – MY GARDEN
Keep your plants organized in a personal collection. Add plants to My Garden and keep their information and your care notes together for easy reference.

PLANT ARTICLES
Explore articles about plants and the natural world. Learn about plant characteristics, growing habits, and care topics to build your knowledge at your own pace.

Discover, learn, and build your plant care routine with Plant App.
